notes: Version 2.41 records ENT-E2 2.2, ENT-Note 1.3.1 and Foundation 2.5.1. These versions state that the matched-block result S_ent(n) = log r_pair(n) of ENT-E1 holds under a supplied purity of the joint state, which ENT-E1 does not derive; ENT-E2 2.2 no longer calls it unconditional. In the registry, the ENT-Note entry, table row and graph node state the formula under ENT-Note's closure hypothesis (supplied purity with diagonal pairing) and, for independently sampled blocks, ENT-E2's further conditions; the general-block conditions of the ENT-E2 entry, table row and graph node, and the ENT-E1 and ENT-E2 bibliography notes, now carry that purity, and the ENT-E2 note also the O17 transfer gap; the ENT-E1 table row's status separates w_j = 1 from the flat spectrum given a supplied purity.
